context: A teacher and a uni intern plan a school exhibition
purpose: Teach: 出展/移譲/監修/補欠/採点/燃焼/立証/責務

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、来月の文化祭で美術部の作品を出展する件、手伝ってもらえる？
lines.en: Ren, can you help with exhibiting the art club's works at next month's school festival?
lines.style: Warm teacher tone, slightly hurried, inviting collaboration with respect

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろんです。先生から監修いただけるなら心強いです。
lines.en: Of course. It's reassuring if you can supervise it.
lines.style: Polite university intern, eager and humble, mid-low pitch

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実は今年から運営の一部を学生に移譲したいの。蓮さんに任せたい部分も多くて。
lines.en: Actually, I want to hand over part of the running to students this year. There's a lot I want to entrust to you.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly confiding, gentle senior-to-junior delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 光栄ですが、責務の重さを考えるとちょっと緊張しますね。
lines.en: I'm honored, but considering the weight of the responsibility, I'm a bit nervous.
lines.style: Honest, softly anxious, sincere young adult speech

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫。担当が急に休んだ時の補欠要員も用意してあるから。
lines.en: It's fine. I've also arranged backup people in case someone suddenly takes leave.
lines.style: Reassuring and practical, calm organized teacher voice, steady delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 助かります。あと、出品作の採点はどなたが行うんですか？
lines.en: That helps. Also, who'll be grading the submitted works?
lines.style: Curious, businesslike, clarifying logistics politely, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 外部の審査員を呼ぶ予定。教育的価値があると立証できる作品を選んでもらうの。
lines.en: We plan to invite outside judges. They'll pick works that can be proven to have educational value.
lines.style: Informative and slightly formal explanation, steady measured pace, professional tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。学生たちも完全燃焼できる舞台になりそうですね。
lines.en: I see. Sounds like it'll be a stage where the students can give it their all.
lines.style: Encouraged and optimistic, slightly brightening tone, sincere youthful warmth

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなってほしい。じゃあ来週、ひとつひとつ詳細を詰めていきましょう。
lines.en: I hope so. Then next week, let's work through the details one by one.
lines.style: Warm closing, forward-looking, gentle leadership, personal cadence that sets them apart
